items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: No, we used to play out at Spanish Ford, Nappy and I played with Johnny Bison.

ctx.x: When did you all ever play together for the first time? Not until the Crosby Band? You must have played down there.
No, we used to play out at Spanish Ford, Nappy and I played with Johnny Bison. Come on, get it here, man. That's right, I forgot. I forgot about that.
Sure, he used to play out at Spanish Ford, Tokyo Gardens. My first band was the Owls, New Orleans Owls.

items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: That's where Nappy and, and, and Bouchon came with the band, see.

ctx.x: And that's, that, that, that's the, that's where we came back and we played that. That's where Nappy and, and, and Bouchon came with the band, see. And then Lefty Ironman came with the band.
